title: Let Swift Package Manager fetch AlgoChat from this repository
description: Let Swift Package Manager fetch AlgoChat from this repository
no_spec_change_rationale: The wire format is unchanged. Package.swift moves to the repository root and points at the existing Swift sources.
acceptance_criteria: swift test from the repository root builds the AlgoChat library and its unit tests. A package can depend on https://github.com/CorvidLabs/algochat.git and use the AlgoChat product.
